items.title: Brain cell mapping lays groundwork for better treatments for conditions like dementia
items.description: A major effort from brain researchers around the world has yielded a cellular atlas of the basal ganglia — structures key to learning and controlling motor skills.

items.title: Far from home. Voyager 1 is now farther than anything man has sent into space
items.description: NASA's Voyager 1, which is the furthest man-made object from Earth, is set to reach a new milestone this week. On Wednesday, the probe will be roughly 16 billion miles from Earth.

items.description: Coal miners who are exposed to silica dust are at a higher risk of black lung disease. Despite decades of advocacy, new efforts to regulate the toxic dust are under threat.

items.description: The film Being Heumann tells the lesser-known story of the mother of the disability rights movement. A new generation of activists share how they "carry the torch" today.
